llm_condensed_answer:
SUMMARY: The OpenTelemetry Collector's Metrics consumer interface needs to be updated to add a new ConsumeMetricsWithContext method with ConsumeOption support for enhanced flexibility. This change requires updating the core interface definition and will affect all metric processors and exporters in the pipeline, including Jaeger's span metrics functionality.

FILES:
- opentelemetry-collector/consumer/metrics.go — Defines the core Metrics interface that needs the new method
- opentelemetry-collector-contrib/connector/spanmetricsconnector/connector.go — Implements Metrics consumer for span metrics (Jaeger use case)
- opentelemetry-collector-contrib/connector/countconnector/connector.go — Implements Metrics consumer for telemetry counting
- opentelemetry-collector-contrib/connector/failoverconnector/metrics.go — Wraps Metrics consumers with failover logic
- opentelemetry-collector-contrib/connector/metricsaslogsconnector/connector.go — Converts metrics to logs
- opentelemetry-collector-contrib/connector/signaltometricsconnector/connector.go — Transforms signals to metrics
- opentelemetry-collector-contrib/connector/roundrobinconnector/connector.go — Distributes metrics across consumers
- opentelemetry-collector-contrib/connector/routingconnector/metrics.go — Routes metrics based on conditions
- opentelemetry-collector-contrib/connector/exceptionsconnector/connector_metrics.go — Aggregates exception metrics
- opentelemetry-collector-contrib/connector/servicegraphconnector/connector.go — Generates service graph metrics
- opentelemetry-collector-contrib/cmd/golden/internal/consumer.go — Test implementation of Metrics interface
- opentelemetry-collector/consumer/consumertest/sink.go — Test implementation for consumer testing
